notes.title: Soon to become FREE :)
notes.content:
Hi everyone, first off i wish you are all doing well and staying safe, it is with pleasure that i announce that both my games "The 111th Soul" and "Not in Heaven" will become free in a week or sooner, it is a gift to everyone in hope to give a tiny bit of a good time during this challenging period, and i deeply thank every person who bought and played the games while they had a price, your support means a lot to me, Thank you for every constructive review to my two first small games :) , i will strive to improve my future games with your support and incentive ;)

I wish you all the best 
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here comes Update 1.2 with some bug fixes:

-Fixed some minor light flickering on some intel integrated graphics.
-Fixed a bug where sometimes camera stopped working after a autosave load.
-Fixed a bug where sometimes camera stopped working after Emily gets killed and autosave is loaded.

Thank you all for your constant support, and "Not in Heaven" will be at a special price during 10 days, starting tomorrow ;)
Best Regards
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Hi, first of all I want to apologize for the inconvenience some users have been experiencing with the game, all I want is that everyone can enjoy this little game that I made with all my heart over this last year, :) 

Here come the patch notes:

-Fixed issue where the interactions sometimes stopped working
-Changed the Camera System to a Third-person controlled camera
-Some performance tweaks
-The main-menu intro can now be skipped

NOTE: Due to the changes made to the game system, the old SAVE files are no longer compatible with this version.

Further improvements are in the making, any suggestions and support are most welcome.

Best regards
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: A fix is on its way
notes.content:
First of all, i would like to apologize for the trouble some have been experiencing with the controls and sometimes the interactions, i am currently working on a fix to address those issues, if you are having trouble with the interactions i kindly ask you give some time before leaving negative feedback before experiencing the game, it took me more than a year to create this game hoping to give you a different experience  i am just one normal person with a everyday life and job and i am trying to fix that for you as fast as possible.


Best regards
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: Just a few hours left to launch :)
notes.content:
Hi everyone, just a few hours remaining for "Not in Heaven" to be avaiable for you to play 😉, it is my second developed game, i thank all of you for the suport i have been receiving and i hope that you all enjoy this experience.

Cheers
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: Adding more languages
notes.content: Hi everyone, just to inform that there are being added, German, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese languages, thank you all for your patience and support ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Almost there ;)
notes.content:
I just want to say a big Thank You to all the supporters and that the game is almost ready for launch, just a final polishing and testing is being done, as for the price for the game I have been thinking and I have decided to go for something around 2,99$, for me the game is worth a bit more, but at the same time I want that most people can play it, so if you like please wishlist and help Emily trough many horrors to get her back to her father.

Happy Holidays Everyone ːsteamhappyː
Ricardo Pratas

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content: Hi everyone, it is with great pleasure that i announce my next solo developed game "Not in Heaven" i hope that you all will enjoy this surreal adventure ːsteamhappyː
